ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark) pixels dominate approximately 90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels accounting for roughly 10% in localized regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular spots scattered throughout; primary clusters located at distal tips; diffuse mottling patch observed on the upper distal region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate vertex angle of 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge shows high-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys; left lobe trailing edge shows lower-frequency, shallow irregularities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit a convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular high-contrast spots concentrated at the left and right tips; secondary smaller clusters and individual spots distributed across both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical white linear marks present in the lower-central and mid-left quadrants of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular erosions and tissue loss along the right trailing edge; dense calcareous barnacle growth at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced morphological asymmetry between the trailing edges of the left and right lobes.
